illustrative_sensitivity.caveat: Algebraic scenario, not an intervention effect; pooled policies differ and prevented failures need not score like observed survivors.

limitations: No event seeds or random assignment presumed
Adaptive development data, not fresh confirmation
Wilson intervals are descriptive at observed n, not anytime-valid
Normalized dimensions are not action marginal returns
List prices and tokens do not measure subscription quota

planning.caveat: Normal approximation and pooled variance for planning only; this is not a stopping rule or a guarantee.

scope: Exported terminal results; descriptive analysis, not a selection or causal estimate. Actor/origin/environment cells stay separate.

trace_availability.caveat: Missing locally can mean the trace lives only in cloud or another machine; not proof of data loss.
